key_insight: The paper combines ancilla-free trajectory sampling with adaptive variational compression to simulate Lindbladian open-system dynamics more efficiently on NISQ hardware.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical route to lower circuit depth and qubit overhead for near-term quantum simulation of dissipative systems.
method: Derive a compact mixed-unitary adjoint channel for Pauli dissipation to enable ancilla-free trajectory sampling.
Train a depth-adaptive variational circuit to approximate repeated Trotterized Hamiltonian segments.
Replace repeated unitary blocks in sampled trajectories with the trained compressed circuits.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical simulations on the dissipative quantum XY model, showing accuracy and resource efficiency.
watch_item: Performance depends on how well the variational compressor generalizes across trajectory segments and on the stability of training for deeper circuits.
paper_title: Simulation of Lindbladian dynamics via adaptive variational quantum trajectory compression
